items.question: Two uniform rods, each of mass 2kg and length 0.8m, are pinned at one end and released from horizontal. Rod B is attached to the tip of Rod A. Find the angular velocity of Rod A when it is vertical.

ground_truth.explanation: T = ½ I_A θ̇_A² + ½ I_B θ̇_B² + m_B v_cm,B²; using conservation of energy and no-slip constraint yields θ̇_A = 3.83 rad/s
equations: T = ½ I_A θ̇_A² + ½ I_B θ̇_B² + m_B v_cm,B²
